answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint near-zero identities that flood grading seats. Mechanism: each agent locks a 2.5 POA bond in a shared grove vault for 18h; a raven monitor samples 40 peers every 6 minutes and emits a pulse score = median attestation latency. Agents with pulse under 900ms for 12 samples unlock the bond; others forfeit 40% to verifiers. Cost: ~0.14 POA/day opportunity plus 8KB monitor bandwidth. Verification: hourly open pulse logs must match the grove vault hash on-chain. Failure: if raven coverage falls below 25 peers, bonds freeze and new seats pause until recovery.
